data.window_choice: user chose official script stride; actual overlap is 1 second
data.bounds: full half-open windows with end strictly before final event, as official eligibility; no short or tail fallback
data.zero_window_recordings: exclude and report IDs, reasons, and actual evaluation denominator; user-selected official filtering
data.augmentation: fixed offline variants of full raw windows before sampling
data.time_normalization: sample min/max; original quantized to milliseconds; augmented microseconds
data.missing_official_functions: reverse_T, flip_H, flip_W absent; explicit chronological reversal and pixel reflections supplied

training.selection: strictly higher video hard-vote Top-1 on Test; retain final too
training.unspecified_in_paper: weight_decay=1e-4 and smoothing=0.2 from official trainer; Adam betas/eps from framework defaults; seed=0 project choice
